description: New York statewide assessment-roll source (all 57 counties outside New York City) (ORPTS, via Open NY) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md, docs/registry/collection.md, and the review record in docs/registry/sources/ny-orpts-rolls.md.

sources.publisher: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance, Office of Real Property Tax Services (via Open NY, data.ny.gov)
sources.license: OPEN-NY Terms of Use (last modified 2013-03-08): a non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the Content; the terms state they impose no attribution, share-alike, re-posting or pre-approval requirements, and that so long as the use is lawful 'you may use it as you wish, subject to no other requirements'. The dataset carries no license field on the portal. Assessment rolls are public records (N.Y. Real Property Tax Law §516; Public Officers Law art. 6)
sources.redistribution: Permitted (OPEN-NY terms: no attribution or share-alike requirement); attribution given anyway: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance. No statute restricting commercial use of assessment rolls was found; Public Officers Law §89(2)(b)(iii) treats the sale or release of lists of names and addresses used for solicitation or fund-raising as an unwarranted invasion of privacy, which is why natural-person owners are never stored
sources.notes: Dataset 7vem-aaz7 'Property Assessment Data from Local Assessment Rolls': final rolls filed by 996 cities and towns (all of New York State except New York City; village rolls not included), about 4.7 million parcels a year, roll years 2021 to 2025, posted annually (last update 2026-04-24). Owner names are present (first, middle, last, suffix, three additional owners). The full table is too large to fetch for one county's commercial parcels, so each file is a filtered SODA CSV: roll_year 2025, one county, property_class 400-499 (commercial) or 700-799 (industrial), 31 of 93 columns, ordered by swis_code,print_key_code, $limit 100000 (2025 counts: Suffolk 42,709; Nassau 29,138; Westchester 37,533; Erie 25,800; Monroe 13,641). Statewide extension 2026-11-03: one file per county for all 57 counties outside New York City (the five Tier 2 counties first, then the other 52 alphabetically; county names exactly as in county_name, e.g. 'St Lawrence'); 306,221 class 4xx/7xx rows in roll year 2025, 275,995 of them in scope (SODA group-by counts); the largest county file is Suffolk's 42,709 rows, under the 100,000 limit. New York City's boroughs are not in this dataset and are loaded from ny-nyc-dof. Change roll_year in the URLs when the next roll is posted. robots.txt: Crawl-delay 1; /browse search pages disallowed, /resource/ and /api/ allowed. The OPEN-NY terms' prohibition on bots sits in the 'Public Participation' section (same reading and same open question as ny-dos-entities); the portal platform's own terms (socrata.com) still need a human read.
